# PromptScript

> Prompt-as-Code for Enterprise AI. Standardize, audit, and deploy instructions across any AI coding assistant.

PromptScript is an agent platform configuration language. It defines instructions, skills, agents, MCP servers, plugins, hooks, workflows, and policies once, then compiles native output for 50 AI coding agent targets.

Every page below is plain Markdown. The whole documentation in one file: https://getpromptscript.dev/llms-full.txt

## Start

- [Getting Started](https://getpromptscript.dev/getting-started/index.md): Install the PromptScript CLI, create your first .prs file, and compile native instructions for Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and 47 more AI coding agents.
- [Enterprise Tutorial: Building Layered AI Infrastructure](https://getpromptscript.dev/tutorial/index.md): Step-by-step enterprise tutorial: build organization, team, and project layers in PromptScript and compile them to native AI agent configuration.
- [Real-Life Tutorial: Checkout Service](https://getpromptscript.dev/examples/real-life-checkout-service/index.md): Roll out PromptScript in a production checkout service with shared policy, payment-specific rules, native agents, CI drift checks, safe takeover, and rollback.
- [PromptScript vs Manual Configuration](https://getpromptscript.dev/guides/vs-manual/index.md): Compare managing AI instructions manually vs with PromptScript
- [FAQ & Troubleshooting](https://getpromptscript.dev/guides/faq/index.md): Answers to common PromptScript questions: supported AI tools, installation, inheritance, private registries, CI/CD, and common errors.

## Migrate

- [Importing Existing AI Instructions](https://getpromptscript.dev/guides/import/index.md): Convert CLAUDE.md, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other AI instruction files into PromptScript
- [Migration Guide](https://getpromptscript.dev/guides/migration/index.md): Migrate existing CLAUDE.md, Copilot, and Cursor instructions to PromptScript step by step, then compile them back to every AI tool.
- [AI Migration Best Practices](https://getpromptscript.dev/guides/ai-migration-best-practices/index.md): Guidelines for AI models performing PromptScript migration
- [Upgrade 1.15 to 1.16](https://getpromptscript.dev/guides/upgrade-1-15-to-1-16/index.md): Safe upgrade workflow for PromptScript syntax, block shapes, replacement operations, and Factory hooks

## Agent Platform

- [Agent Platform](https://getpromptscript.dev/features/index.md): Define instructions, skills, agents, tools, integrations, and automation once, then compile them to native AI coding agent formats.
- [Agents](https://getpromptscript.dev/features/agents/index.md): Define specialized AI agents once and compile them to native platform-specific agent formats.
- [Skills and Resources](https://getpromptscript.dev/features/skills/index.md): Build portable AI skills with instructions, contracts, references, scripts, assets, and target-native output.
- [MCP Servers and Plugins](https://getpromptscript.dev/features/integrations/index.md): Configure project MCP servers and bundle reusable agent capabilities with PromptScript plugins.
- [Hooks and Workflows](https://getpromptscript.dev/features/automation/index.md): Define portable agent lifecycle hooks, reusable workflows, and repository compilation automation.
- [Target Platforms](https://getpromptscript.dev/features/target-platforms/index.md): Configure 50 built-in AI coding agent targets and choose native output modes for instructions, skills, agents, integrations, and automation.
- [AI Tool Hooks](https://getpromptscript.dev/guides/hooks/index.md): Auto-compile .prs files and protect generated outputs using native AI tool hooks
- [Examples (Few-Shot Prompting)](https://getpromptscript.dev/guides/examples/index.md): Teach AI assistants with structured input/output examples using @examples

- [Building Skills](https://getpromptscript.dev/guides/building-skills/index.md): Create custom skills for PromptScript - from simple instructions to parameterized skills with resource files

- [Skill Overlays Guide](https://getpromptscript.dev/guides/skill-overlays/index.md): Extending and customizing skills across registry layers with @extend
- [Local Skills](https://getpromptscript.dev/guides/local-skills/index.md): Install and manage skills directly in your project without a registry
- [Skill Contracts](https://getpromptscript.dev/guides/skill-contracts/index.md): Define inputs and outputs for skills to create clear interfaces

- [Guides](https://getpromptscript.dev/guides/index.md): Guides for composing and reusing PromptScript: inheritance, multi-file projects, Markdown imports, and shared registries.

- [Multi-File Organization](https://getpromptscript.dev/guides/multi-file/index.md): Organize large PromptScript projects across many .prs files with @use imports, fragments, and a clear directory layout.
- [Markdown Imports](https://getpromptscript.dev/guides/markdown-imports/index.md): Import skills directly from .md files with @use in PromptScript. No extra tools needed.
- [Build Your Registry](https://getpromptscript.dev/guides/registry/index.md): Learn how to create and manage PromptScript registries for your organization, with self-service registry commands and decentralized architecture.

- [Enterprise Setup](https://getpromptscript.dev/guides/enterprise/index.md): Roll out PromptScript across an organization: shared registries, layered inheritance, policies, and governed AI instructions per team.

- [Security Guide](https://getpromptscript.dev/guides/security/index.md): Security considerations for PromptScript templates and inheritance

- [Docker](https://getpromptscript.dev/guides/docker/index.md): Run the PromptScript CLI in Docker: image tags, volume mounts, environment variables, and validate or compile commands in containers.
- [User-Level Configuration](https://getpromptscript.dev/guides/user-config/index.md): Configure default PromptScript settings for your developer environment

## Reference

- [Reference](https://getpromptscript.dev/reference/index.md): PromptScript reference: language specification, block shapes, CLI commands, configuration file, model catalog, and telemetry.
- [Language Reference](https://getpromptscript.dev/reference/language/index.md): Complete PromptScript language specification: file structure, blocks, values, inheritance, imports, extensions, and diagnostics.
- [File Anatomy](https://getpromptscript.dev/reference/language/file-anatomy/index.md): Complete PromptScript 1.6 file structure and recommended declaration order
- [Values and Block Bodies](https://getpromptscript.dev/reference/language/values-and-block-bodies/index.md): PromptScript values, canonical block shapes, compatibility forms, and PS038
- [Composition and Precedence](https://getpromptscript.dev/reference/language/composition/index.md): Normative inheritance, import, and local composition precedence
- [Execution Order](https://getpromptscript.dev/reference/language/execution-order/index.md): PromptScript 1.6 declaration order and deterministic resolution
- [Merge and Replacement](https://getpromptscript.dev/reference/language/merge-and-replacement/index.md): Choose between @extend, field replacement, and @override
- [Section Headers](https://getpromptscript.dev/reference/language/section-headers/index.md): Customize generated human-readable section titles with @header
- [Versions and Diagnostics](https://getpromptscript.dev/reference/language/versions-and-diagnostics/index.md): PromptScript syntax versions, upgrade commands, and release validation
- [Block Shapes](https://getpromptscript.dev/reference/block-shapes/index.md): Canonical content shapes, compatibility forms, merge rules, and formatter behavior for every built-in PromptScript block
- [CLI Reference](https://getpromptscript.dev/reference/cli/index.md): Reference for every prs CLI command: init, compile, validate, diff, import, skills, registry, hooks, and their options.
- [prs hooks](https://getpromptscript.dev/reference/cli/hooks/index.md): CLI reference for the prs hooks command (install and uninstall)
- [prs hook](https://getpromptscript.dev/reference/cli/hook/index.md): CLI reference for the prs hook command (pre-edit and post-edit actions)
- [Configuration](https://getpromptscript.dev/reference/config/index.md): Reference for promptscript.yaml: targets, output versions, registries, inputs, validation, formatting, and other project settings.
- [Model Catalog](https://getpromptscript.dev/reference/models/index.md): Built-in model profiles, floating aliases, and the model name each target writes.
- [Anonymous Usage Telemetry](https://getpromptscript.dev/reference/telemetry/index.md): Fields, delivery behavior, and controls for PromptScript telemetry

## Examples

- [Examples](https://getpromptscript.dev/examples/index.md): Runnable PromptScript examples: minimal setup, composition, hooks, agents, skills, team and enterprise layouts, and Git registries.
- [Minimal Example](https://getpromptscript.dev/examples/minimal/index.md): The smallest working PromptScript project: one .prs file compiled to GitHub Copilot instructions, then extended to Claude Code and Cursor.
- [Composition and Order](https://getpromptscript.dev/examples/composition-and-order/index.md): Resolve inheritance, imports, local blocks, extension, and replacement step by step
- [Merge vs Replace](https://getpromptscript.dev/examples/merge-vs-replace/index.md): Runnable comparison of @extend, field replacement, and @override
- [Fix Block Shape Warnings](https://getpromptscript.dev/examples/fix-block-shapes/index.md): Diagnose PS038 and migrate target-dependent block bodies to canonical forms
- [Custom Section Headers](https://getpromptscript.dev/examples/custom-section-headers/index.md): Localize generated headings without changing target-native schemas
- [Portable Hooks](https://getpromptscript.dev/examples/portable-hooks/index.md): Repository-local lifecycle policy with scripts, project cwd, terminal events, and target overrides
- [Migrate Factory Hooks](https://getpromptscript.dev/examples/migrate-factory-hooks/index.md): Safely move PromptScript-owned Factory hooks from legacy settings to the canonical hook file
- [Agent Platform Examples](https://getpromptscript.dev/examples/agent-platform/index.md): Runnable examples for agent integrations, automation, plugins, field replacement, portable skills, and monorepo builds.
- [Agents Example](https://getpromptscript.dev/examples/agents/index.md): Learn how to define portable AI agents and compile them to native agent formats.
- [Team Setup Example](https://getpromptscript.dev/examples/team-setup/index.md): Share one team PromptScript configuration across many projects with inheritance, and keep per-project overrides small.
- [Enterprise Example](https://getpromptscript.dev/examples/enterprise/index.md): Full enterprise PromptScript setup: organization base, compliance and security layers, design system, and governed project configs.
- [Skills & Local Memory](https://getpromptscript.dev/examples/skills-and-local/index.md): Advanced features for AI tool skills and private instructions
- [Git Registry](https://getpromptscript.dev/examples/git-registry/index.md): Use a Git repository as a PromptScript registry to share base configs, skills, and guards across projects and teams.
